note: Question types as they appear in real CUET UG 2025 papers (S4). Most live rows have question_type = null, so an engine must classify from the stem. Patterns are case-insensitive JavaScript regex sources, tried in the order listed; the first match wins. 'dbTypes' lists question_type values already used in MockMob data that mean the same thing.

single_mcq.label: Single-correct MCQ
single_mcq.nta: One stem, four options (1)-(4), one correct. Includes 'Which of the following is NOT ...' and one-statement 'identify the correct statement' items whose options are full sentences.

match_the_following.label: Match List-I with List-II
match_the_following.nta: Four items (A)-(D) in List-I, four (I)-(IV) in List-II, then 'Choose the correct answer from the options given below'. Options are mappings like '(A)-(II), (B)-(III), (C)-(IV), (D)-(I)'.

sequence_ordering.label: Arrange in sequence / chronological order
sequence_ordering.nta: Four items (A)-(D) to put in order: process steps, chronology, increasing/decreasing property, ranking. Options are permutations like '(B), (A), (D), (C)'.

sentence_rearrangement.label: English: rearrange parts of a sentence
sentence_rearrangement.nta: 'Rearrange the following parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence: (A) ... (B) ... (C) ... (D) ...'. Counted under the Para Jumbles chapter.

statement_based.label: Multi-statement selection
statement_based.nta: Statements (A)-(D) followed by 'Choose the correct answer from the options given below'; options are combinations like '(A), (B) and (C) only'.

assertion_reason.label: Assertion (A) and Reason (R)
assertion_reason.nta: Not seen in any 2025 paper read; reported in 2026 History, Political Science and GAT shifts. Standard four options.

synonym.label: English: word similar in meaning
synonym.nta: 'Select the word similar in meaning to the given word: Munificent'.

antonym.label: English: word opposite in meaning
antonym.nta: 'Select the word opposite in meaning to the given word: Sagacious'.

idiom_phrase.label: English: idiom or phrase meaning
idiom_phrase.nta: Standalone idiom/phrase meaning items (idioms also appear inside Match the Following).

fill_in_blank.label: English: choose the correct word or phrase for the blank
fill_in_blank.nta: 'Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the given sentence'. Tests word choice, tense, prepositions, phrasal verbs. Counted under Correct Word Usage.

passage_set_item.label: Question inside a passage or case set
passage_set_item.nta: English: passages first. Domain papers: two passages of five questions at Q41-45 and Q46-50 ('Read the passage carefully and answer the questions').
passage_set_item.detect: Row has passage_group_id / passage_id, or shares a passage text with other rows.
